summary: The tested low-risk extraction is cycle-equivalent but does not recover FPGA area: placed ALMs rise39001->39048 (+47), and needed ALMs rise36300->36406 (+106). The parallel-mask variant also worsens standalone synthesis. Production RTL and v16 remain unchanged.
selectionReason: A had the smaller standalone synthesis result and the smallest proof surface. Its full controlled fit is not beneficial, so it is rejected rather than adopted. No additional speculative architecture is introduced to force a savings claim.
recoveryAssessment: No ALMs recovered: the experimental fit uses47 additional sites. The retained production implementation stays at39001 placed ALMs, not39048.
fanoutFinding: The peak changes from ARM9669 to sprite_capture9560 (-109). z80_set5898->5903; vdp2_regs_set5426->5464; has_restart1415->1432. Bank controls still drive4800 endpoints, and sprite_clear drives4778. This is not a material reduction in the wide-control regime.
packingExplanation: Fitted logic ALUT rises45604->45618 (+14), despite the mapped298-ALUT reduction; routing ALUT falls19245->19168 (-77). Design-implementation FF45246->45251 (+5) and routing-optimization FF3081->3010 (-71), with101 I/O FF unchanged, reconcile the fitted FF delta-66. Controller own fitted ALUT6601->6801 (+200), FF14726->14729 (+3); its estimated hierarchy allocation rises79.6 needed/69.2 placed ALMs. Other hierarchy effects offset part of that rise. The placed-minus-needed gap falls2701->2642 (-59), so calling the whole result packing degradation would be misleading. Physical resynthesis/remapping and placement erase the pre-fit saving; neither snapshot storage nor the wide fanout regime disappears.
furtherWork: No further material saving is demonstrated by the tested low-risk formulations. Centralized/staged/RAM-backed restore remains an unmeasured, larger correctness-risk experiment; no savings forecast or semantic reduction is justified by these results. Development-format consolidation has no measured area benefit in this task.
classificationReason: The simpler structural candidate fails the resource objective even though the exact controller miter passes and timing remains positive. The alternative register-mask formulation increases mapped logic substantially. The result is limited to the tested low-risk candidates; it is not a proof that no alternative architecture could ever save area. No unbeneficial production change is retained.
roadmap: D. reconsider F01 architecture before implementation
nextTask: Before F01 implementation, establish a physical-ALM and M10K budget against the unchanged current baseline (2909 unplaced ALMs,66 free M10Ks), and assess the intended architecture within that budget under separate authorization. This does not prove F01 cannot fit or require an architectural replan; it requires a measured capacity plan instead of assuming mux cleanup or format consolidation will create room. No F01/F06/FM functional investigation or design was performed here.
